description: A reverb with the treated and untreated signals blended at one output

params.text: Sets how long the tail takes to die away
Rolls the high frequencies off the tail, so it darkens as it decays
Crossfades between the incoming signal and the reverb
Takes the effect out of the circuit, fading rather than switching so nothing clicks

inputs.text: Added to the DECAY knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
Added to the DAMP knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
Added to the BLEND knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
A trigger here takes the effect out of the circuit, and a second trigger puts it back

outputs.text: The reverb blended with the incoming signal

inputs.4: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
